_comment: Which completed-item passives the TFT engine models, keyed by the item's apiName in the MetaTFT data.
An item's plain stats come from its stat line automatically; this file only covers the text below it.
Numbers are never written here: each effect references a row of the item's own curve table, with
`scale` / `minusOne` / `mult` to turn the row's tooltip convention into an engine unit (fractions).
Effects the engine knows: precision, ampVsTank, asPerSecond (+asStackDuration), adPerAttack (+maxStacks,
asAtMax), adapPerAttack (+maxStacks, ampAtMax, adapPerHit), apPerInterval (+interval), apAfter (+at), ampPerCrit
(+ampDuration, maxStacks), manaPerAttack, manaPerCrit, manaMult, adapMult, startingMana, adPct, ap,
asPct, crit, amp, armor, mr, manaRegen, byRole, sunderOnHit, shredOnHit, burnOnHit, sunderAura,
shredAura, burnAura, ionicSpark, allyHealPct, hoj; and, for the fights where the dummies hit back: hpMult,
durability, durabilityAbove, attackDamageTaken, thorns, resistsPerAttacker, healPerInterval, regenMissingPct,
shieldAtHp (no duration = until broken), shieldAtStart, resistsAtStart, untargetableAtHp, manaAtHp.
Omnivamp and durability on a stat line are read automatically. `note` is shown in the dashboard as what
stays unmodeled. `excluded` items are left out of the enumeration entirely.
_note: Healing, shields, durability and the other defensive passives only matter to fighters and tanks, whose dummies hit back; a carry is never hit in its fight, so those items rank by their plain stats there.

DA_BrambleVest.note: the thorns hit the dummies adjacent to the unit: everyone in the clump, the attacker spread out

DA_Crownguard.note: the ability power lands when the shield's time is up, whether or not it broke earlier

DA_DragonsClaw.note: the two-second heal cadence is in the item's text, not its table

DA_Evenshroud.note: the aura only reaches the dummies from a unit whose range is within it

DA_GargoyleStoneplate.note: every dummy still standing counts as attacking in the fights where they hit back

DA_GiantSlayer.note: the bonus amp applies to the two tank dummies, not the third

DA_HandOfJustice.note: attack damage and ability power double above half health, the omnivamp below it (a carry is never hit, so it keeps the doubled stats)

DA_HextechGunblade.note: the ally healing is counted, not simulated

DA_IonicSpark.note: the aura only reaches the dummies from a unit whose range is within it; the mana-burn damage fires when a dummy casts, which only happens in the fights where they hit back

DA_Morellonomicon.note: the wound does nothing to a dummy

DA_ProtectorsVow.note: the proc shield has no stated duration, so it lasts until broken

DA_RedBuff.note: the wound does nothing to a dummy

DA_StrikersFlail.note: crit is an expected value, so each attack adds a crit-chance share of a stack

DA_SunfireCape.note: the burn is applied to the current target

DA_TitansResolve.note: stacks from attacking and, where the dummies hit back, from being hit; Unstoppable at full stacks does nothing here

excluded.DA_ThiefsGloves: Thief's Gloves — two random items each round, and it takes all three slots
excluded.DA_TacticiansCape: Tactician's Cape — team size, no combat stats
excluded.DA_TacticiansCrown: Tactician's Crown — team size, no combat stats
excluded.DA_TacticiansShield: Tactician's Shield — team size, no combat stats
